lines.zh: 轻盈跳跃，绿色身影在夜空中划过。
lines.en: Leaps lightly, green form glides through the night.

lines.zh: 绿色皮肤闪烁着微光，脚步轻盈。
lines.en: Green skin glows softly, feet move with grace.

lines.zh: 绿色神秘人轻巧地在藤蔓上跳跃。
lines.en: Mysterious man jumps lightly on vines.

lines.zh: 轻步行走，仿佛融入夜晚。
lines.en: Walks softly, blending with the night.

lines.zh: 每一步都悄无声息，绿色身影缓缓前行。
lines.en: Every step silent, green form moves slowly.

lines.zh: 在藤蔓间游走，寻找着夜的养分。
lines.en: Wanders among vines, seeking night's nourishment.

lines.zh: 轻盈地跳跃，穿梭于黑暗的藤蔓。
lines.en: Jumps lightly, weaving through dark vines.

lines.zh: 绿色皮肤在月光下闪烁，脚步无声。
lines.en: Green skin glows in moonlight, steps silent.

lines.zh: 轻巧跳跃，消失在黑暗中。
在夜幕中跳跃，如梦如幻。
lines.en: Jumps in the night, like a dream.
The moss of the nightmare layer is soft.
I walk slowly along the cracks.

lines.zh: 绿光在脚下拖出一道痕。
lines.en: A green trail follows my feet.
I have to walk around this layer's fog.

lines.zh: 我在找可以坐下歇脚的地方。
lines.en: I'm looking for a spot to rest.

lines.zh: 没人陪我说话，走路也闷。
lines.en: Nobody talks to me. Walking is dull.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，等待着夜晚的呼唤。
lines.en: Stands quietly, waiting for night's call.

lines.zh: 绿色神秘人静静地栖息在藤蔓上。
lines.en: Mysterious man rests quietly on vines.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，享受夜晚的宁静。
lines.en: Stands quietly, savoring the night's peace.

lines.zh: 绿色皮肤在月光下显得格外神秘。
lines.en: Green skin glows mysteriously under moonlight.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息，夜色中的一抹绿。
lines.en: Rests quietly, a green spot in the night.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，享受着夜晚的静谧。
lines.en: Stands quietly, enjoying the night's quiet.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息，等待着未知的惊喜。
lines.en: Rests quietly, waiting for unknown surprises.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，沉浸在这宁静之中。
lines.en: Stands quietly, immersed in this quiet.

lines.zh: 静静地栖息，等待着夜色的降临。
lines.en: Rests quietly, waiting for the night.

lines.zh: 静静地站立，享受着这神秘的夜晚。
lines.en: Stands quietly, enjoying this mysterious night.

lines.zh: 我数这层只有几块石头。
lines.en: I count the few stones on this layer.
My green robe has gathered dust.
I sit and watch the fog crawl.
The second layer is terribly quiet.

lines.zh: 我在等一个愿意交易的人。
lines.en: I wait for someone willing to trade.
Only a few old coins are left in my pocket.

lines.zh: 凝视着玩家，眼中闪烁着好奇。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes full of curiosity.

lines.zh: 绿色的眼睛注视着玩家，探寻着。
lines.en: Green eyes peer at the player, seeking answers.

lines.zh: 绿色神秘人注视着玩家，似乎在思考。
lines.en: Mysterious man gazes at the player, seemingly in thought.

lines.zh: 静静地注视着玩家，神秘莫测。
lines.en: Silently stares at the player, mysterious.

lines.zh: 眼中露出好奇，注视着玩家。
lines.en: Eyes full of curiosity, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 神秘的眼神注视着玩家，似乎能洞察一切。
lines.en: Mysterious gaze stares at the player, seeming to see all.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，眼神中带着一丝神秘。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes hinting at mystery.

lines.zh: 绿色神秘人注视着玩家，眼神复杂。
lines.en: Mysterious man stares at the player, eyes complex.

lines.zh: 凝视着玩家，试图了解一切。
lines.en: Stares at the player, trying to understand everything.

lines.zh: 绿色神秘人注视着玩家，眼神中带着探寻。
lines.en: Mysterious man stares at the player, eyes full of exploration.

lines.zh: 你带着什么可换的东西？
lines.en: What do you have to trade?
Rarely does anyone climb up here.

lines.zh: 绿袍底下，血是雾的颜色。
lines.en: Beneath my green robe, my blood is the color of fog.
My green glow dims by one shade.

lines.zh: 这层的雾咬着我的伤口。
lines.en: The fog of this layer gnaws at my wound.

lines.zh: 这片树林是我们的乐园。

lines.en: I wear green and only trade.
This place has plenty of food.
I have a decent piece of armor here.

lines.zh: 这层的路我认得最清楚。
lines.en: I know the roads of this layer best.
Don't leave empty-handed. Look at my wares.

lines.zh: 跟我来，前面有东西给你看。
lines.en: Come along. There's something ahead to show you.
This green robe of mine does not take hits well.
Don't touch me, I get mad.

lines.zh: 我提着绿灯笼，找另一盏。
lines.en: I carry a green lantern, looking for another.

lines.zh: 梦里第二层，只有我一个绿的。
lines.en: Second layer of the dream, and only I am green.

lines.zh: 这层梦里，另一个绿影在哪。
lines.en: Where is the other green shape in this dream?

lines.zh: 绿色的斗篷下，我也想要个伴。
lines.en: Under this green cloak, I'd like company too.

lines.zh: 我感到一阵凉意穿透了我的皮肤。
lines.en: A chill runs through my skin.

lines.zh: 这片草地看起来很美味。
我必须找到新的栖息地。
lines.en: I must find a new habitat.

lines.zh: 这片森林让我感觉安心。
你看起来像是我的朋友。
我注意到了这片土地的变化。
lines.en: I noticed changes in the land.

lines.zh: 你身上的光芒吸引了我。

lines.en: I'm ready to attack this threat.
I'll wait for the right moment.

lines.zh: 绿色能量环绕，攻击敌手！
藤蔓间闪现，神秘人出现！

lines.en: A hole is burned through my green coat.

lines.zh: 我从梦的边缘滑下去了。
lines.en: I slid off the edge of the dream.
The blast blew my robe away.
The spell passes through my robe and scatters into fog.
Lightning strikes; a hole burns through my green robe.
I'm falling and can't grab hold.
